description: Find alternative fuel stations near a location: electric (EV) charging, CNG, LNG, E85, hydrogen, propane, biodiesel. Used by route planning agents, fleet operators, and EV/clean-fuel tech.

fuel_type.description: Comma-separated fuel types: ELEC (default), CNG, LNG, E85, HY, LPG, BD.

lat.description: Latitude. Use with lon as alternative to location.

location.description: Address or city/state. Either location OR lat+lon required.

lon.description: Longitude. Use with lat as alternative to location.

status.description: Optional status filter: E (available, default), P (planned), T (temporarily unavailable).

name: nrel_alt_fuel_stations
